rationales: Cancer is uncontrolled cell growth, not accidental cell death.
Apoptosis is programmed cell death, not accidental death.
Necrosis is the accidental death of cells and tissues.
Metastasis is the spread of cancer cells to other parts of the body.
Phylum is a classification rank above class, not the basic unit.
Class is a classification rank above order, not the basic unit.
Species is the basic unit of classification.
Order is a classification rank above family, not the basic unit.
The nucleus mainly stores genetic material and controls cell activities.
Ribosomes synthesize proteins rather than serving as the main energy-production centres.
The cell membrane regulates movement of substances into and out of the cell.
Mitochondria produce most of the cell’s usable energy through cellular respiration.
Plants generally have cell walls.
Animals lack cell walls.
Fungi have cell walls.
Bacteria have cell walls, although their wall composition differs from that of plants.
Lipase breaks down lipids.
Protein is broken down by proteases, not lipase.
Carbohydrates are broken down by carbohydrases, not lipase.
Hormones are not the specific substrate of lipase.
Glycolysis does not occur in the vacuole.
Ribosomes are sites of protein synthesis, not glycolysis.
The Golgi complex modifies and packages substances, not glycolysis.
Glycolysis occurs in the cytoplasm.
Churning is the mixing of food in the stomach, not the wave-like movement along the alimentary canal.
Emulsification breaks large fat globules into smaller droplets.
Absorption is the uptake of digested nutrients into the body.
Peristalsis is the wave-like contraction and relaxation that moves food along the alimentary canal.
Physics studies matter, energy, and their interactions.
Chemistry studies substances and their properties and reactions.
Biology is the scientific study of living things.
Farming is an agricultural practice, not the scientific study of living things.
Medicine is the broad practice of preventing and treating disease, not the transplant procedure itself.
Kidney transplantation is a surgical procedure.
Physiology studies how living organisms and their parts function.
Lithotripsy uses shock waves to break stones and is not kidney transplantation.
Two senses are not the full set of senses used for observation.
Three senses are not the full set of senses used for observation.
Four senses leave out one of the five traditional senses.
Biologists use all five traditional senses for observation.
Potato is Solanum tuberosum, not Allium cepa.
Carrot is Daucus carota, not Allium cepa.
Allium cepa is the scientific name for onion.
Pea is Pisum sativum, not Allium cepa.
Mitochondria contain a matrix rather than stroma.
Ribosomes do not contain stroma.
The Golgi body does not contain stroma.
Stroma is the fluid-filled region inside chloroplasts surrounding the thylakoids.
A hypertonic solution has a higher solute concentration than the comparison solution.
An isotonic solution has the same solute concentration as the comparison solution.
A hypotonic solution has a lower solute concentration than the comparison solution.
A hydrophyte is a plant adapted to living in water, not a type of solution.
Prophase is one stage of mitosis and is relatively brief compared with interphase.
Cells spend most of their life in interphase, growing and carrying out normal functions.
Metaphase is a short stage of mitosis when chromosomes align at the cell’s equator.
Telophase is a short stage of mitosis when new nuclei form.
Pepsin is a digestive enzyme, not the general example of a biological detergent enzyme intended here.
Protease is used in biological detergents to break down protein stains.
Glycogen is a storage carbohydrate, not an enzyme.
Trypsin is a specific digestive protease, but protease is the general detergent enzyme listed as the answer.
